title: Add GPU benchmark evidence harness
description:
Add benchmark support for reproducible GPU evidence across LDPC, BCH, and scheduler work.

## Background

The GPU prototype wave needs repeatable benchmark commands and raw artifacts that reviewers can inspect. The harness should capture batch sweeps and phase timings where possible.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Benchmark support records hardware/ROCm metadata, commit hash, comparator identity, command line, and raw result path for each run.
- [hard] Batch-size sweeps include the design workload and at least one smaller and larger batch size.
- [hard] Phase timing support covers CPU preparation, H2D copy, kernel execution, D2H copy, synchronization/waiting, and postprocessing where the production path exposes those boundaries.
- [hard] Output format is machine-readable enough for threshold checker scripts and human-readable enough for lead review.
- [hard] Default workspace CI remains green without ROCm installed.
